subject: Lareth the Beautiful
fact: Lareth the Beautiful is referenced as the leader of the Fire Temple whose body was found in the Moathouse after being slain by Sequoia.
source_quote: Lareth was furious, having seen through the party's lies that the Deep Temple stole the Chest of Rao.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse contains an inner sanctum, a secret mechanism that drops an iron grate, a false wall that triggers a trap related to the grate, and a chamber guarded by six intelligent Bugbears.
source_quote: They discovered a secret mechanism that dropped an iron grate, blocking a passage, and found evidence that pulling a seemingly false wall triggered a trap related to the grate.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr used a dose of Dust of Disappearance to become invisible, retreated to a corner, and later attacked one of Lareth's Mirror Images, confirming it was fake before hiding again.
source_quote: Zephyr using a dose of Dust of Disappearance to become invisible, retreating to a corner to position himself for a later sneak attack. Zephyr emerged from invisibility and attacked one of the illusory Lareths, confirming it was a fake before retreating to hide again.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia immediately engaged the visible guards, quickly dispatched several of Lareth's goons, and was paralyzed by Lareth's Hold Person spell.
source_quote: Zinnia and Sequoia immediately engaged the visible guards, quickly dispatching several of Lareth's goons and carving a path through the room. Lareth used his magic to paralyze both Zephyr and Zinnia with Hold Person.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia engaged the visible guards, dispatched several of Lareth's goons, traded blows with Lareth and the remaining guards, was not paralyzed, and delivered the killing blow to Lareth the Beautiful.
source_quote: Zinnia and Sequoia immediately engaged the visible guards, quickly dispatching several of Lareth's goons and carving a path through the room. Sequoia and Zinnia traded blows with Lareth and the remaining guards... Seeing his opportunity, Sequoia, who was not paralyzed, struck the killing blow, felling Lareth the Beautiful.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was severely wounded by Lareth's Inflict Wounds, burned his healing magic early to stay in the fight, and focused on healing himself under the relentless assault of Lareth's sergeant, Sarge.
source_quote: Lareth retaliated by summoning a Mirror Image of himself, confusing his attackers, and severely wounding Calmer with Inflict Wounds. Calmer was forced to burn his healing magic early to stay in the fight. Calmer focused on healing himself under the relentless assault of Lareth's sergeant, Sarge.

subject: Sarge
fact: Sarge is Lareth's sergeant who relentlessly assaulted Calmer during combat and was later dispatched after Lareth's death.
source_quote: Calmer focused on healing himself under the relentless assault of Lareth's sergeant, Sarge. With Lareth dead, the remaining guards and Sarge were quickly dispatched.

subject: Thorne (Duke)
fact: Thorne (Duke) was contacted by the party to perform a clean-up job for a 50 GP fee, and the party ensured the area was safe for him to work.
source_quote: The party contacted Thorne (Duke), agreeing to pay him a 50 GP fee for the clean-up job. To ensure the area was safe for Thorne to work, they explored the remaining Moathouse dungeon.

subject: Gnolls
fact: Eight Gnolls, allies of Lareth via a local Gnoll King, were deceived into believing Lareth was 'busy' and that a pay raise was imminent, stalling them from discovering his body.
source_quote: They encountered a large group of eight Gnolls who were allies of Lareth's via a local Gnoll King. Using deception, they successfully convinced the Gnolls that Lareth was merely 'busy' and that a pay raise was imminent, stalling them from discovering Lareth's body.

subject: Bugbears
fact: Six intelligent Bugbears were guarded a chamber and were persuaded by the party that Lareth was dead and the Moathouse was ripe for pillaging, causing them to run off and fight the Gnolls.
source_quote: Further exploration led them to a chamber guarded by six intelligent Bugbears. The party used their greatest weapon—chaos—by telling the Bugbears that Lareth was dead and that the entire Moathouse was now ripe for pillaging. They successfully persuaded the Bugbears to run off and fight the Gnolls for the plunder.

subject: Osler Goodingut
fact: Osler Goodingut is a local council member in Hommlet who was presented with proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and agreed the party must go to Nulb.
source_quote: The party returned to Hommlet and gathered the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo. They presented their undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and the death of Lareth.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne is a local council member in Hommlet who was presented with proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and agreed the party must go to Nulb.
source_quote: The party returned to Hommlet and gathered the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo. They presented their undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and the death of Lareth.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus is a local council member in Hommlet who was presented with proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and agreed the party must go to Nulb.
source_quote: The party returned to Hommlet and gathered the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo. They presented their undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and the death of Lareth.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo is a local council member in Hommlet who asserted that the next step was vital: the party must travel to Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there.
source_quote: Jaroo asserted that the next step was vital: the party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there, disrupt their machinations, and identify who was truly in charge.

subject: Mace of Smiting
fact: A Mace of Smiting was found among Lareth's loot after his death.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail (which no one could wear), and a Ring of Free Action.

subject: Ring of Free Action
fact: A Ring of Free Action was found among Lareth's loot after his death.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail (which no one could wear), and a Ring of Free Action.

subject: Silver service set
fact: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP was found among Lareth's loot after his death.
source_quote: Wealth: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP, a fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP, and various gems (ungets) worth 800 GP.

subject: Fire opal necklace
fact: A fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP was found among Lareth's loot after his death.
source_quote: Wealth: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP, a fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP, and various gems (ungets) worth 800 GP.

subject: Chest of Rao
fact: The Chest of Rao was stolen by the Deep Temple and recovered by the party, who retained possession of it after defeating Lareth.
source_quote: Lareth was furious, having seen through the party's lies that the Deep Temple stole the Chest of Rao... The session concluded with the adventurers poised to head north to Nulb, still in possession of the invaluable Chest of Rao.

subject: Gaining a level
fact: All four adventurers gained a level after defeating Lareth, acquiring new abilities such as Sequoia's Uncanny Dodge.
source_quote: Critically, following this major victory, all four adventurers gained a level, increasing their power and acquiring new abilities, such as Sequoia's Uncanny Dodge.

subject: Clearing the Moathouse
fact: The party successfully cleared out the Moathouse operation by defeating Lareth, his guards, Sarge, the Gnolls, and the Bugbears.
source_quote: The party had successfully cleared out the Moathouse operation.

subject: Stalling the Gnolls
fact: The party used deception to stall the Gnolls from discovering Lareth's body by convincing them he was 'busy' and a pay raise was imminent.
source_quote: Using deception, they successfully convinced the Gnolls that Lareth was merely 'busy' and that a pay raise was imminent, stalling them from discovering Lareth's body.

subject: Persuading the Bugbears
fact: The party used chaos to persuade the Bugbears that Lareth was dead and the Moathouse was ripe for pillaging, causing them to flee and fight the Gnolls.
source_quote: The party used their greatest weapon—chaos—by telling the Bugbears that Lareth was dead and that the entire Moathouse was now ripe for pillaging. They successfully persuaded the Bugbears to run off and fight the Gnolls for the plunder.

subject: Council agreement in Hommlet
fact: The local council in Hommlet agreed that the party must travel to Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations, while they prepared the militia.
source_quote: The council members agreed that while they prepared the militia, the adventurers needed to continue their disruptive work in secret.

subject: Hommlet
fact: Hommlet is the town where the party gathered the local council, presented proof of the Temple's resurgence, and received the directive to travel to Nulb.
source_quote: The party returned to Hommlet and gathered the local council members: Osler Goodingut, Burne, Rufus, and Jaroo.

subject: Nulb
fact: Nulb is the city to which the party is directed to travel to infiltrate the Temple's operations, disrupt their machinations, and identify who is in charge.
source_quote: Jaroo asserted that the next step was vital: the party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there, disrupt their machinations, and identify who was truly in charge.

subject: Rannos
fact: Rannos was one of two individuals whose deaths preceded the party's misdirection in Hommlet.
source_quote: moments after having executed their elaborate misdirection in Hommlet following the deaths of Rannos and Gremag.

subject: Gremag
fact: Gremag was one of two individuals whose deaths preceded the party's misdirection in Hommlet.
source_quote: moments after having executed their elaborate misdirection in Hommlet following the deaths of Rannos and Gremag.

subject: Dust of Disappearance
fact: Zephyr used a dose of Dust of Disappearance to become invisible during combat with Lareth.
source_quote: Zephyr using a dose of Dust of Disappearance to become invisible, retreating to a corner to position himself for a later sneak attack.

subject: Mirror Image
fact: Lareth summoned a Mirror Image of himself to confuse his attackers during combat.
source_quote: Lareth retaliated by summoning a Mirror Image of himself, confusing his attackers.

subject: Inflict Wounds
fact: Lareth used Inflict Wounds to severely wound Calmer during combat.
source_quote: Lareth retaliated by summoning a Mirror Image of himself, confusing his attackers, and severely wounding Calmer with Inflict Wounds.

subject: Hold Person
fact: Lareth used Hold Person to paralyze Zephyr and Zinnia during combat.
source_quote: Lareth used his magic to paralyze both Zephyr and Zinnia with Hold Person, immobilizing the two primary damage dealers.

subject: Gnoll King
fact: The Gnoll King is the local leader to whom the eight Gnolls are allied via a connection to Lareth.
source_quote: They encountered a large group of eight Gnolls who were allies of Lareth's via a local Gnoll King.

subject: Bugbears
fact: Six intelligent Bugbears guarded a chamber in the Moathouse and were persuaded by the party to attack the Gnolls.
source_quote: Further exploration led them to a chamber guarded by six intelligent Bugbears.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil is the organization that has resurged, with Lareth as its leader in the Moathouse, and whose operations the party must now disrupt in Nulb.
source_quote: They presented their undeniable proof of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence and the death of Lareth.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is the sect led by Lareth the Beautiful, whose reign ended with his death in the Moathouse.
source_quote: felling Lareth the Beautiful and ending the reign of the Fire Temple leader in the Moathouse.

subject: Deep Temple
fact: The Deep Temple is the organization falsely accused of stealing the Chest of Rao by Lareth.
source_quote: Lareth was furious, having seen through the party's lies that the Deep Temple stole the Chest of Rao.

subject: Magical Plate Mail
fact: Magical Plate Mail was found among Lareth's loot but could not be worn by anyone in the party.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail (which no one could wear), and a Ring of Free Action.
